retake.retakeFee: Additional application/exam fee required after 3 failed attempts

gdl.nightCurfew: No driving midnight-5 a.m. for the first 12 months (provisional), with work/emergency exceptions
gdl.passengerLimits: No more than 1 passenger under 21 who is not family, for the first 12 months

requiredDocuments: Proof of U.S. citizenship or lawful presence (e.g. passport or birth certificate)
Verification of enrollment/driver education (VOE and DE-964) for applicants under 18
process.realIdNotes: Texas driver licenses are REAL ID compliant when you present proof of identity, SSN, U.S. citizenship or lawful presence, and two proofs of Texas residency.
process.visionStandard: 20/40 in at least one eye, with or without corrective lenses

facts.bacLimitUnder21: Any detectable amount of alcohol (zero tolerance under 21)
facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: No current point system; license may be suspended for 4 or more moving-violation convictions in 12 months, or 7 or more in 24 months
facts.moveOverRule: Move over a lane or slow to 20 mph below the posted limit for stopped emergency, TxDOT, tow, and utility vehicles displaying flashing lights
facts.interstateMaxSpeed: 75 mph (up to 85 mph on some posted toll roads such as SH 130)
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: 20 mph when the reduced-speed zone is in effect; handheld phone use is prohibited in active school zones
